limitations: Annual period/phase interpretation and availability remain prototype assumptions, not observed demand.
All cases and participant identities are synthetic; source stock is person-topic records, not unique people.
No group practice, shorter practice, instruction efficacy or extra trainer capacity is assumed.
Joined follow-ups use the declared horizon as their planning limit; failed full bundles retain first-start scheduling and escalate.
Drain extends planning availability as well as observation; its joined first-year booking prefix need not equal the year-only run.
Zero-age frozen backlog is an explicit convention; its exact old-state competence/proof breakdown is unknown.
Twenty paired replications may miss precision targets; no posthoc stopping or global ranking.
Cost is valued consumed work including participant time, not cash spend; unknown IT/implementation/room costs remain excluded.
rationale: Two paired replications for portable execution verification; not selection evidence.
